stories.title: Barley polysaccharide fermentates from Bifidobacterium longum investigated in colorectal cancer models
stories.takeaway: A food–microbe fermentation product was associated with colorectal cancer suppression in experimental models.
stories.what_happened: A November 21 npj Science of Food study reports that fermentates of barley polysaccharides produced by Bifidobacterium longum were associated with changes in Wnt/β-catenin signaling and metabolic profiles.
stories.why_it_matters: Connects microbial biotransformation of dietary polysaccharides to experimentally testable host responses in colorectal disease.
stories.caveat: The available publisher information does not establish human anticancer efficacy or isolate which fermentation products are causal.

stories.title: Microfluidic purpurin microparticles and thermosensitive hydrogel evaluated for periodontitis
stories.takeaway: Microfluidic particle fabrication was combined with a temperature-responsive hydrogel for localized experimental anti-inflammatory delivery.
stories.what_happened: A November 21 Scientific Reports paper describes a purpurin microparticle–hydrogel hybrid and reports reduced inflammation and alveolar bone loss in a rat periodontitis model.
stories.why_it_matters: Illustrates microfluidic formulation as a tool for localized biomaterial-based drug delivery.
stories.caveat: Rat outcomes cannot establish human dental efficacy, and formulation performance may vary with tissue context.

stories.title: Dietary chitosan oligosaccharides linked to Salmonella resistance and mucosal IgA
stories.takeaway: Diet-associated microbial metabolism and IgA responses were examined alongside resistance to enteric infection.
stories.what_happened: A November 20 npj Biofilms and Microbiomes study investigates dietary chitosan oligosaccharides, indole metabolism and IgA responses in the context of Salmonella infection.
stories.why_it_matters: Highlights connections among dietary substrates, microbial metabolism and mucosal defense against intestinal pathogens.
stories.caveat: Associations and experimental context should not be interpreted as evidence that supplementation prevents Salmonella infection in humans.

stories.title: Population-based study examines aspirin exposure and metastatic colorectal cancer at diagnosis
stories.takeaway: Registry-based evidence evaluates whether low-dose aspirin use is associated with synchronous metastatic colorectal cancer.
stories.what_happened: A November 21 British Journal of Cancer article analyzes low-dose aspirin exposure and synchronous metastatic colorectal cancer using population-based registry data.
stories.why_it_matters: Offers a clinical epidemiology counterpart to experimental colorectal cancer studies and underscores the distinction between association and intervention.
stories.caveat: Observational data are vulnerable to confounding and do not establish that aspirin prevents metastatic disease.

stories.title: Review compares mechanical cues shaping mesenchymal stem cell differentiation
stories.takeaway: A structured review emphasizes that tensile strain, compression, shear and hydrostatic pressure have context-dependent effects on MSC fate.
stories.what_happened: Published November 20 in Communications Biology, the review synthesizes mechanotransduction studies and highlights cell-source, mechanical-dose, scaffold and donor variability.
stories.why_it_matters: Provides a broadly applicable framework for designing controlled human-relevant mechanobiology platforms.
stories.caveat: A narrative synthesis is not a meta-analysis; many reported effects are model-specific and clinical translation remains uncertain.
